notes.title: Build A Friend - release is at 18th June 2024
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046626/02d33fc711097e3abe3ee0739b0bb6eb9c684f25.jpg[/img]
It's coming soon. We are ready to release our game Build A Friend at 18th June 2024.
We prepared two game modes:
[list]
[*]Levels challenge. 
[*]Factory building.
[/list]
Levels challenge allows you to collect rewards and money. Than you can repair your friends at the Factory building mode.
